title: Distinguish AGVs “In the System” vs “In the Map” (Purple Disconnected vs Removed from Map)
summary: Use the Map Monitor’s counts and AGV/map association behavior to explain why an AGV can be present in RMS/system counts but not appear as an active map member—specifically the “purple AGV” disconnected case (turned off but still associated to the map) versus the “removed from the map” case (removed from map association but still part of the system).
when_to_use: When you need to interpret Map Monitor counts and map display for AGVs that are associated with RMS/system but are not added/associated with the active map view—especially to distinguish “purple AGV” disconnected (turned off but still in the map) from “removed from the map” (no longer associated with the map view).
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a corrective action guide for changing AGV safety states (e.g., E-stop). This runbook is for interpretation of map/system association behavior only.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Use Map Monitor counts and AGV/map visual indicators (e.g., purple disconnected) to correctly explain whether an AGV is still associated with the viewed map or has been removed from the map association while remaining in the system.
access_or_tools_needed: Ability to observe AGV presence on the map and any color/status indicator (purple AGV described in training)
Ability to view the counts for AGVs in the map vs AGVs in the system but not added to the map

system_preconditions: You can access the Map Monitor message panel/counts and the map view where AGVs are displayed.

visual_references.description: Map Monitor message panel showing the relevant counts (active robot count, disconnected count) and the explanation of “in the system but not in the map” vs disconnected/removed behavior.
Robot selection overview showing robot color meaning, including “Purple: robot disconnected”.

steps.title: On the Map Monitor, identify the two related counts: AGVs “in the map” vs AGVs “in the system but not added to the map.”
steps.purpose: Establish which AGVs are currently associated with the viewed map versus only present in the RMS/system roster.
steps.instruction: Open the Map Monitor and locate the count panel that shows (a) AGVs “in the map” and (b) AGVs “in the system but not added to the map.”
steps.expected_result: You can see two distinct counts: one for AGVs in the map (example shown: 57) and one for AGVs in the system but not added to the map (example shown: 34).
steps.healthy_condition: The two counts are visible and correspond to the map association split described in the training (left side “in the map” vs right side “in the system but not added to the map”).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot locate the two counts on the Map Monitor, or the map association split you observe does not align with the expected “in the map” vs “in the system but not added to the map” interpretation.

actions.label: Locate map association counts
actions.exact_action: Identify the left/right counts on the Map Monitor for AGVs “in the map” and “in the system but not added to the map.”

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot find the counts or the UI does not match the described Map Monitor count panel, escalate for deeper troubleshooting of map association/state.

steps.title: Interpret the “purple AGV” case: turned off but not removed from the map.
steps.purpose: Correctly explain why an AGV remains visible on the map (as disconnected/purple) even though it is turned off.
steps.instruction: On the map, look for AGVs displayed as “purple” (robot disconnected). Then interpret that behavior as: the AGV was turned off but not removed from the map association.
steps.expected_result: You can explain that a turned-off AGV still appears on the map as a “purple AGV,” meaning it is disconnected and still in the map.
steps.healthy_condition: AGVs shown as purple correspond to the disconnected meaning described in the robot color legend (purple = robot disconnected).
steps.failure_condition: If an AGV’s map behavior does not match the purple/disconnected vs removed-from-map definitions (e.g., it disappears from the map when expected to remain, or remains when expected to be removed), escalate for deeper troubleshooting of map association/state.

actions.label: Check for purple disconnected AGVs
actions.exact_action: Observe the AGV color/status indicator on the map and identify any AGV shown as purple (robot disconnected).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the observed map behavior does not match the purple/disconnected definition (turned off but still in the map), escalate for deeper troubleshooting of map association/state.

steps.title: Interpret the “removed from the map” case: removed from map association but still part of the system.
steps.purpose: Correctly explain why an AGV remains in RMS/system counts but no longer appears on the viewed map after removal from map association.
steps.instruction: When an AGV is no longer associated with the viewed map, interpret that as “removed from the map” while it remains part of the system. Confirm by observing that the AGV no longer appears on the map view you are looking at, even though it can still be counted as part of the system roster.
steps.expected_result: You can explain that once an AGV is removed from the map, it no longer appears/associates with the map you are viewing, but it is still part of your system.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV is absent from the map view while the system still reflects it as part of the system roster (consistent with the “in the system but not added to the map” count concept).
steps.failure_condition: If the AGV still appears on the map after you believe it was removed from the map association (or disappears entirely from system expectations), escalate for deeper troubleshooting of map association/state.

actions.label: Verify AGV absence from map view
actions.exact_action: Observe the map view and confirm the AGV no longer appears on the map you are looking at.

stop_or_escalate_if: If observed map behavior does not match the “removed from the map” definition (no longer associated with the map view but still part of the system), escalate for deeper troubleshooting of map association/state.

steps.title: Apply the association logic when explaining counts and map state.
steps.purpose: Provide a consistent explanation for customers/stakeholders: turning off affects disconnected counting/visibility as purple; removing affects map association.
steps.instruction: When asked to explain a mismatch between counts and map display, use the following logic: turning off affects disconnected behavior (purple/disconnected but still in the map), while removing affects map association (no longer associated with the viewed map but still part of the system).
steps.expected_result: You can correctly explain why an AGV appears as purple/disconnected on the map when turned off but not removed, versus why it disappears from the map when removed while still remaining in the system.
steps.healthy_condition: Your explanation aligns with the training’s definitions and the observed Map Monitor counts and map indicators.
steps.failure_condition: If you cannot reconcile the observed counts and map display using the turning-off vs removing association logic, escalate for deeper troubleshooting of map association/state.

actions.label: Explain using association logic
actions.exact_action: Use the turning-off vs removing definitions to interpret the observed Map Monitor counts and map indicators for the AGV(s) in question.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the observed map behavior does not match the purple/disconnected vs removed-from-map definitions, escalate for deeper troubleshooting of map association/state.

success_criteria: You can point to the Map Monitor counts for “in the map” vs “in the system but not added to the map.”
You can correctly explain that turned-off (not removed) AGVs remain on the map as purple/disconnected.
You can correctly explain that removed-from-map AGVs no longer appear on the viewed map while remaining part of the system.
healthy_conditions: Purple AGV behavior matches the robot color legend meaning “Purple: robot disconnected.”
Map association explanation matches the training’s turning-off vs removing definitions.
failure_conditions: Observed map behavior does not match the purple/disconnected vs removed-from-map definitions.
Counts cannot be reconciled with the map display using the association logic.
escalation_guidance: If the observed map behavior does not match the training’s purple/disconnected vs removed-from-map definitions, escalate for deeper troubleshooting of map association/state.
